raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Purpose In a hybrid model, the KV cache groups share one allocation. Layer `j` of every group is a view of the same layer slot, there are as many slots as layers in the largest group, and each slot's page is sized for the largest per-layer state. Groups are kept apart by block ids: a block belongs to one group at a time. The Mooncake store connector registered every layer for every group, and copied whole pages. So each value of a Mamba / linear-attention group also held: - the layer slots of the group's padding layers, which only other groups use, and - the padding of each state up to the page size. Kimi K3 (DCP8) has 3 KDA groups of 23 layers and 1 attention group of 29 layers (24 MLA + 5 drafter), sharing 29 slots of 516,096 B per block. Every key therefore stored 29 × 516,096 B = **14.97 MB**. A KDA group uses only 23 slots, and each KDA state is 457,728 B. The real data is 23 × 457,728 B = **10.53 MB**, so **30% of every KDA value was bytes the group does not use**: 20.7% is the 6 slots of other groups and 9.0% is state padding. A saved KDA state (3 KDA groups × 8 DCP ranks = 24 keys) drops from about 359 MB to 253 MB. This PR: - **Registers each group's own layers only.** Each group's values are built from the regions of that group's own layers, with each Mamba state view as its own region. - **Copies only the used bytes of each block.** `RankLocalStoreLayout` now keeps `block_len` next to `block_stride`. `block_stride` is still the stride used to find a block in the GPU cache, and `block_len` is the number of bytes copied from it: up to the last byte the group uses. Mooncake stores the concatenation of the copied pieces, so the padding never reaches the store. Keys are unchanged. A model with a single KV cache group, or an attention group without padding, stores the same bytes as before. If a group has no layers on a PP rank, its keys are still written from all layers' regions, as before. HiSparse and TP-shared layouts are unchanged. A Mamba value now has one region per state view instead of one per layer slot. The measured put and get times still go down (below). ## Test Plan - Unit tests (`tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/`, all 376 Mooncake store tests pass). The new or changed tests below fail on main: - `test_rank_local_layout_skips_block_padding`: on a layer-outermost buffer, checks the regions, `block_stride` and `block_len`, `prepare_values` sizes (single and multi-block chunks), and `prepare_value_for_block`. - `test_hybrid_mamba_values_hold_only_group_states`: an attention group and a padded Mamba group are overlaid by `allocate_kv_cache`, and each Mamba layer has two state views of different dtypes with a gap between them. The test checks that the saved value is exactly the states of the block. It then clobbers the block and restores it: only the state bytes come back; the gap, the padding and the attention-only layer slot are untouched. - The SWA HMA test now also checks that each group registers only its own region. - Accuracy, Kimi K3 agg (TP8 + DCP8, dspark4 MTP with real rejection): GSM8K 50-shot, two passes. Prompts are ~8.1k tokens, which is more than one 7,168-token store block. Between the passes the GPU prefix cache is reset with `/reset_prefix_cache`, so pass 2 loads from Mooncake. - Perf A/B, Kimi K3 agg (2 GB300 nodes, 1.28 TB Mooncake store, agentic coding traces, 60 min, concurrency 64/80/96). The base build is the same build without this commit. ## Test Result ### Accuracy | pass | prompt tokens | loaded from Mooncake | GSM8K strict-match | |---|---|---|---| | 1 (cold) | 10,747,031 | 0 | 0.9712 ± 0.0046 | | 2 (GPU cache reset) | 10,747,031 | 10,492,800 (97.6%) | 0.9712 ± 0.0046 | Both passes get 1281/1319 correct. ### Stored value sizes Every Mooncake put interval of every run decomposes exactly into whole keys of the two expected sizes. That is 1,548 intervals with this PR and 1,551 on base. | | MLA key | KDA key | KDA share of saved keys | avg MB per saved key | |---|---|---|---|---| | base | 14,966,784 B | 14,966,784 B | n/a | 14.97 | | this PR | 14,966,784 B | 10,527,744 B (= 23 × 457,728) | 57–60% | 12.30–12.43 | ### Effective capacity and hit rate (same 1.28 TB store) "Unexpected miss" comes from a per-request trace audit. It counts prompt tokens whose saved state was stored earlier in the run but did not hit, i.e. tokens that were evicted. | concurrency | keys held at watermark, base → PR | benchmark prefix cache hit | unexpected miss (pts) | of which states > 10 min old | |---|---|---|---|---| | 64 | 83,009 → 96,375 (+16.1%) | 95.02% → 95.35% | 0.92 → 0.62 | 0.47 → 0.21 | | 80 | 82,730 → 95,952 (+16.0%) | 93.34% → 93.98% | 1.86 → 1.17 | 1.30 → 0.70 | | 96 | 82,761 → 95,094 (+14.9%) | 92.56% → 93.41% | 2.55 → 1.66 | 1.59 → 0.87 | ### Performance | concurrency | build | throughput / GPU (tok/s) | TTFT P50 / P90 | P90 ITL | E2E latency P90 | completed requests | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 64 | base | 19,559 | 1.42 / 4.63 s | 57.6 ms | 93.1 s | 4,811 | | 64 | this PR | 20,137 (+3.0%) | 1.38 / 3.77 s | 53.8 ms | 89.5 s | 4,951 | | 80 | base | 18,075 | 6.38 / 21.9 s | 81.5 ms | 125.8 s | 4,991 | | 80 | this PR | 19,140 (+5.9%) | 5.41 / 15.7 s | 73.4 ms | 115.3 s | 5,325 | | 96 | base | 16,039 | 26.6 / 57.6 s | 83.8 ms | 164.6 s | 4,398 | | 96 | this PR | 17,673 (+10.2%) | 25.8 / 53.3 s | 82.0 ms | 157.6 s | 4,880 | Mooncake transfers also shrink: - avg put time: 2.2–2.4 ms → 2.0 ms; - avg get time: 13.4–17.1 ms → 12.5–16.8 ms. There is one run per arm. Earlier runs of the same base store code at the same concurrencies give a sense of run-to-run noise: - hit rate: 95.05 / 93.33 / 92.48%, within 0.08 pts; - unexpected miss: 0.90 / 1.80 / 2.71 pts; - throughput / GPU: within 0.1 / 0.2 / 3.4%. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) --- Need help on this PR?  (SWA + Full) attention config, using a dict-backed mock store."""

@@ -283,6 +301,245 @@ def _fake_thread_init(*args, **kwargs):
     assert worker.lookup(num_tokens=64, block_hashes=hs).hit_length == 0
 
 
+def test_hybrid_mamba_values_hold_only_group_states():
+    """Hybrid groups overlay one allocation. A Mamba group's values hold only
+    its own layers' states: not the layer slot only attention uses, and not
+    the padding of each state up to the attention page. Restoring the value
+    brings back the states."""
+    attn = FullAttentionSpec(
+        block_size=16, num_kv_heads=1, head_size=16, dtype=torch.float16
+    )
+    page = attn.page_size_bytes
+    mamba = MambaSpec(
+        block_size=16,
+        shapes=((4, 8), (2, 8)),
+        dtypes=(torch.float32, torch.float16),
+        page_size_padded=page,
+        mamba_cache_mode="align",
+    )
+    assert mamba.state_content_size_bytes == 160 < page
+    num_layers, num_blocks = 3, 4
+
+    def tensor(layers):
+        return KVCacheTensor(
+            size=num_layers * num_blocks * page,
+            layers=layers,
+            layer_stride=num_blocks * page,
+            block_stride=page,
+        )
+
+    cfg = KVCacheConfig(
+        num_blocks=num_blocks,
+        kv_cache_tensors=[tensor(["A0", "A1", "A2"]), tensor(["M0", "M1"])],
+        kv_cache_groups=[
+            KVCacheGroupSpec(["A0", "A1", "A2"], attn),
+            KVCacheGroupSpec(["M0", "M1"], mamba),
+        ],
+    )
+    worker = _build_worker_with_dict_store(
+        _minimal_vllm_config(cache_block_size=16), cfg, _DictStore()
+    )
+    kv_caches = allocate_kv_cache(cfg, torch.device("cpu"), KVCacheLayout.LBNHC)
+    # Like a Mamba backend, view each layer's page as its two states, here
+    # with a gap between them.
+    for name in ("M0", "M1"):
+        page_view = kv_caches[name]
+        kv_caches[name] = [
+            page_view[..., :128].view(torch.float32),
+            page_view[..., 136:160].view(torch.float16),
+        ]
+    _register_with_fake_threads(worker, kv_caches)
+
+    states = [state for name in ("M0", "M1") for state in kv_caches[name]]
+    state_lens = [state[0].numel() * state.element_size() for state in states]
+    attn_db, mamba_db = worker.token_dbs
+    attn_layout, mamba_layout = attn_db.store_layout, mamba_db.store_layout
+    assert attn_layout.block_len == [page] * num_layers
+    assert mamba_layout.kv_caches_base_addr == [s.data_ptr() for s in states]
+    assert mamba_layout.block_len == state_lens
+
+    raw = torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int8).set_(kv_caches["A0"].untyped_storage())
+    raw.copy_(torch.randint(-128, 128, raw.shape, dtype=torch.int8))
+    before = raw.clone()
+    addrs, sizes = mamba_db.prepare_value_for_block(2)
+    saved = [ctypes.string_at(addr, size) for addr, size in zip(addrs, sizes)]
+    # The value is each state of block 2 in turn.
+    assert saved == [
+        state[2].contiguous().view(torch.int8).numpy().tobytes() for state in states
+    ]
+
+    # Clobber block 2 of every layer slot, then load the saved value: only the
+    # Mamba states come back; the gap, the padding and slot A2 keep the clobber.
+    def block_2(addr, length):
+        start = addr - raw.data_ptr() + 2 * page
+        return slice(start, start + length)
+
+    for name in ("A0", "A1", "A2"):
+        raw[block_2(kv_caches[name].data_ptr(), page)] = 7
+    expected = raw.clone()
+    for state, length in zip(states, state_lens):
+        expected[block_2(state.data_ptr(), length)] = before[
+            block_2(state.data_ptr(), length)
+        ]
+    for addr, data in zip(addrs, saved):
+        ctypes.memmove(addr, data, len(data))
+    assert torch.equal(raw, expected)
+
+
+_ATTN = FullAttentionSpec(
+    block_size=16, num_kv_heads=2, head_size=16, dtype=torch.float16
+)
+_MAMBA = MambaSpec(
+    block_size=16,
+    shapes=((4, 8), (2, 8)),
+    dtypes=(torch.float32, torch.float16),
+    page_size_padded=_ATTN.page_size_bytes,
+    mamba_cache_mode="align",
+)
+# Model shapes as KV cache groups: each group is (layer names, spec).
+_MODELS = {
+    "dense": [(["A0", "A1", "A2"], _ATTN)],
+    "mla": [
+        (
+            ["A0", "A1", "A2"],
+            MLAAttentionSpec(
+                block_size=16, num_kv_heads=1, head_size=40, dtype=torch.float16
+            ),
+        )
+    ],
+    "full_swa": [
+        (["A0", "A1"], _ATTN),
+        (
+            ["S0", "S1"],
+            SlidingWindowSpec(
+                block_size=16,
+                num_kv_heads=2,
+                head_size=16,
+                dtype=torch.float16,
+                sliding_window=32,
+            ),
+        ),
+    ],
+    # Like Kimi K3: Mamba groups with fewer layers, states padded to the page.
+    "attn_mamba": [
+        (["A0", "A1", "A2"], _ATTN),
+        (["M0", "M1"], _MAMBA),
+        (["M2", "M3"], _MAMBA),
+    ],
+    # Pages of different sizes are packed side by side within a block.
+    "mixed_pages": [
+        (["A0", "A1"], _ATTN),
+        (
+            ["B0", "B1", "B2"],
+            FullAttentionSpec(
+                block_size=16, num_kv_heads=1, head_size=8, dtype=torch.float16
+            ),
+        ),
+    ],
+}
+
+
+def _byte_mask(t: torch.Tensor, nbytes: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The bytes of the backing storage that ``t`` covers."""
+    offsets = torch.tensor([t.storage_offset()])
+    for size, stride in zip(t.shape, t.stride()):
+        offsets = (offsets[:, None] + torch.arange(size) * stride).flatten()
+    elem = t.element_size()
+    mask = torch.zeros(nbytes, dtype=torch.bool)
+    mask[(offsets[:, None] * elem + torch.arange(elem)).flatten()] = True
+    return mask
+
+
+def _span_mask(spans, nbytes: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    mask = torch.zeros(nbytes, dtype=torch.bool)
+    for start, length in spans:
+        mask[start : start + length] = True
+    return mask
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("layout", list(KVCacheLayout), ids=lambda x: x.name)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("model", list(_MODELS))
+def test_store_values_round_trip_every_layout(model, layout):
+    """Through the planner's real layout, each group's value for a block holds
+    every byte of its layers' views of that block, reads and writes only that
+    block, and restores it exactly. Without padding the value is the group's
+    whole block, as before; with Mamba padding it is exactly the states."""
+    num_blocks, block = 4, 2
+    groups = [KVCacheGroupSpec(names, spec) for names, spec in _MODELS[model]]
+    planner_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            get_resolved_kv_cache_layout=lambda: layout,
+            num_gpu_blocks_override=num_blocks,
+            prefix_cache_retention_interval=None,
+        ),
+        attention_config=SimpleNamespace(hisparse_config=None),
+    )
+    try:
+        cfg = get_kv_cache_config_from_groups(planner_config, groups, 1 << 30)
+        kv_caches = allocate_kv_cache(cfg, torch.device("cpu"), layout)
+    except (ValueError, AssertionError):
+        pytest.skip(f"{layout.name} cannot express {model}")
+    worker = _build_worker_with_dict_store(
+        _minimal_vllm_config(cache_block_size=16), cfg, _DictStore()
+    )
+    _register_with_fake_threads(worker, kv_caches)
+
+    first = next(iter(kv_caches.values()))
+    raw = torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int8).set_(first.untyped_storage())
+    nbytes = raw.numel()
+    raw.copy_(torch.randint(-128, 128, raw.shape, dtype=torch.int8))
+    before = raw.clone()
+    base = raw.data_ptr()
+
+    # The block of every byte that some layer's view uses (-1: none, e.g.
+    # padding). A value must not reach another block's bytes.
+    byte_block = torch.full((nbytes,), -1)
+    for views in kv_caches.values():
+        for view in views if isinstance(views, list) else [views]:
+            for b in range(num_blocks):
+                mask = _byte_mask(view[b], nbytes)

+                    pytest.skip(f"{layout.name} overlaps blocks of {model}")

+        store_layout = db.store_layout
+        addrs, sizes = store_layout.prepare_value_for_block(block)
+        chunk_addrs, chunk_sizes, _ = store_layout.prepare_values(

+        )
+        # Chunked saves and loads copy the same pieces as a single block.
+        assert chunk_addrs == [addrs, addrs] and chunk_sizes == [sizes, sizes]

+        owned = torch.zeros(nbytes, dtype=torch.bool)
+        for name in group.layer_names:

+        assert not (owned & ~value).any(), "value misses bytes of the group"
+        # Each piece ends at the last byte the group uses in it.
+        assert all(owned[a - base + n - 1] for a, n in zip(addrs, sizes))
+        if len(groups) == 1 and layout != KVCacheLayout.BHLNC:
+            # A single group stores whole blocks, as before. (A BHLNC head's

+        if not layout.is_block_outermost:

+            assert torch.equal(value, owned) and sum(sizes) == owned.sum()

+        # Clobber everything but the other blocks, then load the saved value.
+        saved = [ctypes.string_at(a, n) for a, n in zip(addrs, sizes)]
+        raw[~other_blocks] = 7
+        for addr, data in zip(addrs, saved):
+            ctypes.memmove(addr, data, len(data))
+        assert torch.equal(raw[owned], before[owned])
+        assert torch.equal(raw[other_blocks], before[other_blocks])
+        raw.copy_(before)
